name: Heddohon
description: A web music player for your Navidrome, Subsonic or Jellyfin server

paths.name: Data
paths.description: The SQLite database, setup.json (with the secret the setup page makes), play history, sessions and the cover cache. Back this folder up.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: Heddohon web player, published on host as 6135

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: The user id that owns the app's files. 500 is the MOS default.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: The group id that owns the app's files. 500 is the MOS default.
